notes.title: Announcement: 13 WOOD ST Remastered
notes.content:
SEKS is happy to announce 13 WOOD ST Remastered!

Major changes will be:

updated Steam Achievements (symbols)
new languages (de, fr, it, es)
updated graphics (lighting)
new content (Halloween Theme)

13 WOOD ST Remastered will be rolled out as a series of regular updates
and will be free for all players of 13 WOOD ST!

Source:
https://www.13woodst.com/2022/06/announcement-13-wood-st-remastered.html
